translate_en|mods/Tempo_PerfKit/42/media: Every setting here also lives in Tempo_Config.lua. All settings apply when you press Accept, no restart needed. Only installing or removing the optional engine classes themselves (the manual_installation folder) requires restarting the game.
Classifies frame spikes by what was happening (moving, chunk loading, menus) so you can tell what is causing hitches.
Breathing Tempo icon on this page
Purely cosmetic. Off = plain section header.

How many of the NEAREST zombies get the expensive smooth animation blending. Vanilla 20. Lower = less CPU in hordes; distant zombies blend poses less smoothly. Needs the manual PerformanceSettings.class.
Milliseconds per frame spent finalizing map chunks. Lower = smoother travel, slightly more chunk pop-in. Default 2.5.
Spreads chunk finalization across frames while driving or sprinting instead of one big freeze. Needs the manual IsoChunkMap.class; harmless no-op without it.
Caches text measurements so big modded menus build fast. Self-validates against vanilla and disables itself if results ever differ. Safe to leave on.
keeps bandits fully simulated and in 3D
turning ON from the main menu applies at game start
One summary line per real minute: percentiles, 1 percent lows, jitter, pacing. Handy for before/after comparisons when you change mods.
Puts every Tempo setting on this page back to the shipped defaults. Press Accept afterwards to keep them, or Back to cancel.
Quick right double-tap opens the menu
Stops rapid right-clicks being swallowed as empty double-clicks. Hold-right-click-to-aim is untouched.
installed and matches this game build
installed but built for a DIFFERENT game build - disabled, remove it
cannot be verified from Lua (1-byte constant patch, no sentinel) - see HOW TO INSTALL
Leave OFF if you use TooltipLib or any tooltip mods. Tempo stands down automatically when it detects them, but off is the guaranteed-compatible setting.

Maximum on-screen zombies rendered as full 3D models. Vanilla: 510. Zombies beyond this limit use 2D sprites while remaining visible and fully active. Lower values reduce CPU and GPU load with dense zombie population. Requires the optional IsoWorld.class.
